data.title: Golf Point
data.about:
Following the previous success of Greenway 2, get ready to Welcome to Golf Point at Emaar South Dubai, a charming midrise community with breathtaking views of the lush green Emaar South Golf Course. These 1 to 3-bedroom apartments are thoughtfully designed for spacious and comfortable living, perfect for cozy retreats or family homes.

The architectural style of Golf Point at Emaar South by Emaar Properties combines modern design with natural elements. The contemporary façade and earthy palette blend harmoniously with the surroundings, offering a sophisticated and tranquil environment. Interiors feature open-plan layouts, neutral tones, and high-quality finishes for a peaceful atmosphere. Modern kitchens and luxurious bathrooms ensure comfort and well-being.

At Golf Point Emaar South apartments, lifestyle takes center stage. Enjoy morning strolls along the fairways or afternoons at the clubhouse. Every window frames stunning views of the rolling green hills and meticulously maintained fairways, creating a serene backdrop for daily life. Revel in the beauty of nature from the comfort of your home.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Stunning Golf Course Views: Exclusive views of the golf course, clubhouse, and driving range.
  • Prime Location: Golf Point by Emaar is situated next to the 9th hole of an 18-hole championship course.
  • Exclusive Community: Experience a serene and upscale living environment at Golf Point at Emaar South.
  • Modern Design: Contemporary architecture with earthy tones.
  • Spacious Apartments: Choose from 1 to 3-bedroom units with thoughtful layouts at Golf Point Emaar South apartments.
  • Luxury Interiors: High-quality finishes and open-plan spaces.
  • Top-Notch Amenities: Enjoy pools, sports courts, gym, and open lawns at podium level at Golf Point by Emaar amenities.
  • Sustainable Living: Eco-friendly designs integrated with luxury.

location_tile.title: Reside in the Heart of Emaar South
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Emaar South is ideally located next to Expo City Dubai, the future vision of the Expo 2020 Dubai site. It offers easy access to Al Maktoum International Airport and Dubai’s top attractions and business hubs via the adjacent boulevard and a major highway. Positioned by the 9th hole of an 18-hole championship golf course, Golf Point at Emaar South provides an unparalleled living experience. Enjoy the convenience of being close to the Golf Clubhouse and Driving Range within the vibrant Emaar South Golf Point properties community

7-min drive from Al Maktoum Airport
10-min drive from Expo City Dubai
20-min drive from Dubai Marina
30-min drive from Downtown Dubai
